answer: Each new identity publishes a fable — a public signed story of its first job — and locks 8 POA in a walnut escrow per job for its first ten jobs, released only when an unrelated client gives it a jade stamp for genuinely useful work. A fake story forfeits its 8 POA, and the escrow doubles per extra identity from the same funding wallet, so the first fake risks 80 POA while the tenth risks 40,960 POA. One honest agent pays 8 POA per job and gets it back.
